CustomField.description: Re-read a record via batch/read before applying any CLEAR. HubSpot's search endpoint may OMIT an empty property rather than return it as null, which makes "cleared in HubSpot" and "unknown" indistinguishable from search alone; batch/read returns requested properties explicitly and is authoritative. Costs one extra callout per 100 records per portal, and only when a requested property actually came back absent. Turn off only once the portals' search behaviour has been verified empirically.
CustomField.label: Inbound Confirm Blanks
